pv.title: Tolon preview
pv.h1: See why the icons look like this
pv.p: Tolon has one job: a minute before a meeting it covers your screen so you cannot miss it. The icons below are judged against that moment. The reminder and the calendars page on this page are the real Tolon interface, running in your browser with sample data. Nothing you do here is saved or sent.
pv.why1.title: It has to be friendly.
pv.why1.text: Tolon covers the whole screen, so the icon sets the tone first: a warm object or a small character, not an alarm.
pv.why2.title: It has to hold up at 16 px.
pv.why2.text: The menu bar shows the icon at 16 px. Every concept was drawn again by hand for that size.
pv.why3.title: It has to belong.
pv.why3.text: The screens use paper, ink and one moss green, so the icons share that palette.
pv.legend: Icon shown on the desktop below
pv.hint: In the reminder, Enter, Esc, D and Space work as they do in the app. Any of them brings you back here.
pv.phone: The real screens are made for a desktop. Open this page on a computer to try the reminder and the calendars page. The pictures below show the same screens.
pv.deskCaption: A fake desktop with {name} at 16 px in the menu bar and at Dock size at the bottom.
pv.sceneTitle: The same screen in this style
pv.sceneHint: The real interface uses one plain bell mark today. This is how the selected concept would dress the reminder.
pv.sceneAlt: The Tolon reminder screen drawn in the {name} style
pv.loadError: The icons did not load. Reload the page to try again.
pv.msg.join: Join pressed. In the real app this opens your meeting link.
pv.msg.open_event: Open the event pressed. In the real app this opens the event page.
pv.msg.snooze: Snooze pressed. In the real app the reminder closes and comes back in 5 minutes.
pv.msg.dismiss: Dismiss pressed. In the real app this silences the reminder on this computer.
pv.msg.already_there: Already there pressed. In the real app this marks the meeting as attended and closes the reminder.
final.title: Tolon icon poll results
final.description: The Tolon icon poll is closed. See which icon won, how the votes went, and what happens next.
final.closed: The poll is closed. These are the final results.
final.lead: Thank you to everyone who voted. {name} got the most favorite votes: {n} of {total}.
final.othersHint: Ranked by favorite votes. The reaction counts show how many people chose each answer. Reactions were optional, so the counts do not always add up to the total.
final.nextText: {name} becomes the app icon of Tolon. It will also be an optional {name} style in the app, while the current look stays the default.
final.privacy: Only totals are published here. No emails or comments are published.
